summary: Rewrote parseRepoChatStreamJson to prefer only the last assistant event’s text blocks, skip thinking blocks for assistant and Codex structured content, keep Codex plain-string fallback via collectText, and use truncated result text only when no assistant event exists. Updated repo-chat worker tests for new precedence, multi-turn behavior, thinking exclusion, result-only fallback, and Codex structured-content filtering; adjusted worker integration expectation. Verification passed with pnpm vitest run src/repo-chat/repo-chat-worker.test.ts, pnpm build, and pnpm test.
